query: I just finished planting a whole row of cherry tomato seedlings in my backyard this morning, I’m really hoping they don’t get eaten by the neighborhood squirrels that have been hanging around lately. I also tried out a new matcha latte recipe on the weekend, it turned out way creamier than the ones I get from the café down the street, I’ve been making one every morning since. Oh, and my cat just learned how to knock the treat jar off the kitchen counter, I had to move it to the highest shelf last night to stop her from stealing snacks all day. Anyway, I’m having some issues with my phone: my APN settings seem to be broken, my SIM card is locked with a PIN, my line got suspended because of an overdue bill, and I think my SIM card might be unseated too, can you help me fix these problems?
